rule_title: TTP 1546.007 - Netsh Helper DLL Registered for Persistence
description: Detects use of netsh add helper to register a malicious DLL or executable as a netsh helper. Netsh loads all registered helpers into its process on every invocation, providing persistent code execution through a trusted signed binary. The registered path is written to HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\NetSh and survives reboots.
